3240-6462-8227-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
3240-6462-8227-8347.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Loot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Sela triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Loot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1491-2464-6218-8320.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1491-2464-6218-8320.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

574-1981-2415-7192.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-1981-2415-7192.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

856-5776-6351-8095.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

997-1643-2073-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Clown Car enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1987-2427-4863.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1987-2427-4863.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2427-4863.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1445-2438-4871-7422.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2438-4871-7422.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

339-677-4050-7297.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1497-2173-5220-7286.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

4067-5527-6281-7252.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
4067-5527-6281-7252.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Grave Sifter.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Grave Sifter that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Grave Sifter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat.

339-677-4785-6974.manaNeeded: {3} if Ashling's Command is in your hand
339-677-4785-6974.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. Otherwise, cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Jegantha and choosing any of its remaining modes.
Put the tapped Jegantha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat using the Jegantha token.

719-2366-2921-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
719-2366-2921-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4947-5078-6766-7060.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

147-5686-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities from step 5.

2457-4289-6441-6968.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3234-3293-5231-5413.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5231-5413.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Repeat
3234-3293-5231-5413.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1563-1879-2457-4365.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

710-1052-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1987-2104-2493-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2104-2493-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

703-1308-4313.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Flameshadow Conjuring trigger.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Anointed Procession that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Flameshadow Conjuring trigger, causing you to pay {R} to create a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens with haste.
When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating an extremely large number of Anointed Procession tokens that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

1061-1379-3989-4331.manaNeeded: {8}{U}{U}{U}{U} each turn, plus an additional {1} the first turn if Drafna has summoning sickness
1061-1379-3989-4331.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight permanents and/or have the city's blessing.
1061-1379-3989-4331.description:
If Drafna has summoning sickness, activate Swiftfoot Boots' equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Drafna.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying Timestream Navigator.
When the Timestream Navigators enter the battlefield, if you do not have the city's blessing, they trigger, giving you the city's blessing.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning the nontoken Timestream Navigator from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Swiftfoot Boots' equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Timestream Navigator token.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2034-2762-4365.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1806-2034-3002-3943.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Eternal Scourge is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Rest in Peace.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
 Faldorn triggers, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Wolf, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2320-2493-2499-4598.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{U}{U}.
It is not your turn.
2320-2493-2499-4598.description:
During an opponent's turn, after their upkeep step, cast Reset by paying {U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, targeting Essence Flux and Reset.
Resolve both of Archaeomancer's abilities, returning Essence Flux and Reset to your hand.
Repeat.
